address.streetAddress: 7181 College Pkwy Suite # 20, Fort Myers, Fort Myers, 33907

reviews.author: Robert S…
reviews.body: I had an excellent experience and would highly recommend this place. The atmosphere was clean, relaxing, and welcoming from the moment I walked in. The massage was professional, thorough, and tailored to exactly what I needed. I left feeling noticeably more relaxed and with much less tension than when I arrived. She was friendly and made the entire experience comfortable and enjoyable. I will definitely be returning and would recommend it to anyone looking for a quality massage experience.

reviews.author: Daniel P…
reviews.body: Absolutely fantastic. She is attentive and follows need, knows exactly when to move on and when not to. Good for both effective massage and relaxing repetitive moves, been here 5 times so far and I’m hooked. I’ve tried so many places around here and this is the best, and massage envy is near the bottom. Massage Point was my previous favorite.
